The '''Hanging Valley''' was a location on the frozen world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Located immediately to the west of the [[Clabburn Range/Legends|Clabburn Range]], the valley marked the southern boundary of the [[North Ridge/Legends|North Ridge]]. The easternmost point of the [[Cirque Glacier/Legends|Cirque Glacier]] was also marked by this valley. Hanging Valley was also to the west of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] flew through Hanging Valley. A [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] flew through Hanging Valley when it observed a power surge. A [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] attacked another Probe Droid in this area.
